hardware: QB2, 2x Blackhole p300c (4 dies); every measurement below used ONE die (P150)
summary: The full HF-advertised 262144 context is supported, on a single chip, and is verified both at the model level and through the vLLM serving path. No reduction is claimed and none is needed.

why_it_is_affordable.kv_layers: 10 of 40 (only the gated full-attention layers hold a KV cache; the 30 Gated DeltaNet layers hold none)
why_it_is_affordable.gdn_recurrent_state_note: context-INDEPENDENT: 30 layers x 32 heads x 128 x 128 at bf16 is ~30 MB whatever the sequence length. This is the architectural reason long context is cheap here.
why_it_is_affordable.arithmetic: A dense model of this size would need roughly 21 GB of KV at 256K; this hybrid needs 5.0 GB at bfloat16 and 2.7 GB at bfloat8_b.

model_level_evidence.method: Allocate the paged KV cache each target context requires, prefill a 2048-token prompt through prefill_paged, then run 4 decode steps. bfloat16 KV, i.e. the most expensive option.

serving_evidence.method: vLLM 0.26.0 + the Tenstorrent plugin, one chip, max_num_seqs=1, block_size=64, max_model_len=262144, fabric_config DISABLED, trace_region_size 1 GiB.
serving_evidence.note: At max_num_seqs=1 the plugin sizes its block pool as max_model_len * max_num_seqs, i.e. 262144/64 = 4096 blocks -- the same allocation the model-level probe made.

corrects_a_previous_claim.previous_stated_reason: the engine failed at startup on a 4.3 GB allocation when max_model_len was declared as 131072
corrects_a_previous_claim.finding: UNSUBSTANTIATED. No surviving log in the bring-up records that failure, and the arithmetic never supported it: the whole 262144-token KV cache is 5.0 GB at bfloat16 against roughly 6.5 GB of headroom after weights and the trace region. 4096 was 1.5% of what the model actually does. It has been raised to 262144 with the evidence above rather than justified.
corrects_a_previous_claim.note: A 4.3 GB figure is consistent with a vLLM-side block-pool sizing decision rather than a model limit, which is why this contract records serving evidence separately from model-level evidence.

known_limitations_at_this_context: max_num_seqs remains 1. That is a batching/concurrency limit, not a context limit: the GDN external-state path and the batched serving deadlock are tracked separately.

Prompts shorter than 128 tokens are a separate correctness concern on the serving path: the GDN chunk-prefill kernel requires T >= 128 and T % 32 == 0, and below that the single-device path is documented as silently wrong. This is independent of context length and is being investigated.
Decode-path logit PCC (0.75-0.94) is materially worse than prefill's and the decode graph is not bit-reproducible. Neither is context-dependent.
